_meta.purpose: Machine-readable architecture map of dp-lookup-pro, written for an AI agent picking up this codebase cold.
_meta.line_numbers_caveat: Line numbers drift with edits. Treat them as hints; confirm with grep before relying on them.

project.name: dp-lookup-pro
project.summary: CLI + importable Python library that queries the MCGM Development Plan 2034 ArcGIS MapServer for a Mumbai CTS/CS land parcel and emits a 6-file deliverable bundle.
project.llm_dependency: NONE. No AI library is imported or required. An LLM is an optional convenience for reading the JSON output aloud; it generates none of the deliverables.
project.license: Proprietary, all rights reserved. Evaluation use only. NOT open source.

entry_points.warning: FIXED 2026-07-28. Shebang is now '#!/usr/bin/env python3' and the wrapper is a thin shim over cts_dp_lookup_pro.main().
entry_points.notes: Arg parsing, --no-cache/--fresh flags and the 'WORLI CTS 947' conversational form all live in main(). Returns exit code 1 on error.

entry_points.signature: async def lookup_plot_pro(village, cts_number, output_dir='./output', use_cache=True, cache_ttl_seconds=86400, timeout_seconds=20.0) -> Dict[str, Any]
entry_points.warning: FIXED 2026-07-28. pyproject.toml now has [build-system] (hatchling) and a dp-lookup-pro console script, so `uv pip install -e .` works and the module imports from any CWD.

entry_points.notes: Agent metadata. version/command/parameters keys are non-spec and inert, but harmless.

execution_pipeline.name: Cache lookup
execution_pipeline.detail: Key is '<VILLAGE>:<CTS>'. Entries are {cached_at, result} and expire after cache_ttl_seconds (default 30 DAYS - layer 13 carries LAST_EDITED_DATE 2019-01-23 on every parcel, so geometry is a frozen snapshot; zones/reservations/CRZ change only by gazetted order). A hit also verifies every promised export file still exists, and stamps metadata.cached_at / cache_age_days / cache_expires_in_days so staleness is never silent. Legacy untimestamped entries are treated as expired. Bypass with use_cache=False or --no-cache.

execution_pipeline.name: Parcel resolve
execution_pipeline.on_empty: returns {'error': "Plot not found for CTS '<x>' in village '<y>'"} and stops
execution_pipeline.critical_note: FIXED 2026-07-28. Inputs pass a character whitelist before interpolation, the call is wrapped in try/except httpx.HTTPError, and the body goes through usable_json() so an ArcGIS error payload is not mistaken for an empty result.

execution_pipeline.name: Geometry preparation
execution_pipeline.detail: Computes ring centroid (cx,cy), bbox centre (mcx,mcy), half-extent d = max(50, largest_span/2). Converts Web Mercator to WGS84 with R=20037508.342789244. Builds output subfolder ./output/<village_clean>_cts_<cts_clean>/.

execution_pipeline.name: Task assembly
execution_pipeline.detail: Builds 5 coroutine groups without awaiting: identify, map export, road probes, neighbour probes, satellite tiles.

execution_pipeline.name: Single-batch concurrent fetch
execution_pipeline.detail: One asyncio.gather over all 5 groups, return_exceptions=True, HTTP/2 pool (max_keepalive=30, max_connections=50, timeout=20.0s).
execution_pipeline.critical_note: FIXED 2026-07-28. Failures are now classified: a failed identify aborts the run with an error (no PDF, no Excel row, no cache entry); road/neighbour/tile/map failures become metadata.warnings and suppress caching. metadata.complete reports whether the run was clean. Timeout raised 10s -> 20s.

execution_pipeline.name: Response parsing
execution_pipeline.detail: Roads deduped into road_map keyed 'name|width', preferring entries whose name != 'Exisiting Road' and width != 'N/A'. Neighbours deduped by CTS number, excluding self. Identify results picked by layerId via next(). Every response is parsed via usable_json(), which rejects HTTP 200 bodies carrying an ArcGIS 'error' key.

execution_pipeline.name: Raster rendering
execution_pipeline.detail: DP map: server PNG + Pillow RGBA overlay (plot polygon, north arrow, legend box). Satellite: 3x3 Esri z18 tiles stitched to 768x768, plot polygon reprojected via tile_to_latlon bounds. Saved off the event loop via asyncio.to_thread.

execution_pipeline.name: Vector exports
execution_pipeline.detail: export_geojson (WGS84 CRS84), export_dxf (ezdxf R2010, 11 CAD layers, local metric origin at plot centroid, 1 unit = 1 m, UTM 43N centroid in title block), export_kml (hand-built XML string).

execution_pipeline.name: PDF docket
execution_pipeline.detail: ReportLab SimpleDocTemplate, letter, 2 pages. Page 1: status banner, 10-row attribute table, DP map, QR code to the ArcGIS web map. Page 2: satellite view + adjoining parcel table (first 8).

execution_pipeline.name: Excel register append
execution_pipeline.detail: Appends a 28-column row to <output_dir>/dp-lookups.xlsx, creating headers if the sheet is empty.
execution_pipeline.note: Append-only. Bad runs are never removed and must be pruned by hand.

execution_pipeline.name: Cache write and return
execution_pipeline.detail: Writes {cached_at, result} into the output-dir-scoped store and flushes to disk - but ONLY when metadata.warnings is empty. Returns the 6-section dict.

breakdown.probe_points: bbox centre + 2 bbox corners + midpoints of the 6 longest boundary edges, each nudged ~6 units outward along the edge normal

observed_latency_ms.note: Measured 2026-07-28. README/MEMORY/SKILL latency claims corrected to match.

arcgis_layers.note: Layer IDs are stable on this MapServer. Verify with GET {SERVER_URL}?f=json before changing any of them.

in_use.name: Global_Property_merge_v7
in_use.role: CTS parcel polygons - the primary lookup layer

deliberately_excluded.name: Coastal Districts having CRZ
deliberately_excluded.reason: District-wide polygon. Covers every plot in Mumbai City and Suburban, so including it marks 100% of parcels as CRZ. This caused the original false-positive bug.

known_traps: Layers 193 and 194 have spatial querying DISABLED server-side. Any /query with a geometry - polygon, envelope or point, with or without distance - returns HTTP 200 carrying {'error': {'code': 400}}. Only attribute queries (where=1=1) succeed. Road data must come from /identify, never /query.

Layers 31, 1118, 2212, 2213, 2214, 2240, 2241, 2242, 2243 are all LINE features (High Tide Line, Low Tide Line, CRZ Lines and Boundaries, Hazard Line, etc). A point-identify can never intersect a line, so using them for CRZ detection silently returns NO for every plot. This was the original false-negative bug.

LAST_EDITED_DATE on layer 13 is identical (2019-01-23) for every parcel - it is the bulk load date, NOT a per-parcel edit stamp, so it cannot be used as a cache revalidation key. DP modifications also do NOT appear on the parcel record (APPROVAL_NO is null even for plots that have one); they live in layer 192.

files.units: metres, 1 CAD unit = 1 m, origin at plot centroid

domain_constraints.detail: VILLAGE is matched with exact string equality against 128 valid MCGM revenue village names. These are cadastral survey names, NOT modern locality names.
traps: 'BANDRA' is not valid - use BANDRA-A through BANDRA-I, or BANDRA-EAST
'KURLA' is not valid - use 'KURLA - 1' through 'KURLA - 4' (note the spaces around the hyphen)
'BHANDUP' is not valid - use BHANDUP-E or BHANDUP-W

domain_constraints.detail: CTS_CS_NO is also exact-matched. '16/738' and '16-738' are different. Suffixes matter: '748A' != '748'.

known_issues.detail: return_exceptions=True plus a 10s timeout across a 24-request burst means a slow server produces zone='Unknown', road=None, 0 neighbours, crz='NO'. The run still writes a full PDF, still appends to the Excel register, and still caches the result permanently.
known_issues.impact: A transient network hiccup becomes an authoritative-looking report indistinguishable from a real one.
known_issues.suggested_fix: If the identify result set is empty, do not cache, do not write the PDF, and surface a warning in the returned dict.

known_issues.detail: Degraded results are cached like successes. Observed on 2026-07-28: WORLI:886 cached as zone=Unknown, road=None.
No TTL and no invalidation. Once cached, a plot returns the original zoning and reservation status forever. For a tool informing property decisions, stale DP status is a material risk.
known_issues.suggested_fix: Add a TTL and a --no-cache flag.

known_issues.detail: The parser checks status_code != 200 then reads j.get('features', []). An ArcGIS error body is HTTP 200 with an 'error' key, so it parses as zero features and is reported as 'nothing found'. The two dead road /query calls were removed, but the parser still cannot distinguish an API error from an empty result anywhere else.
known_issues.suggested_fix: Check for an 'error' key in every parsed body before using it.

known_issues.detail: village and cts_number are interpolated into the ArcGIS WHERE clause unescaped. A single quote breaks out of the string literal.
known_issues.suggested_fix: Whitelist [A-Za-z0-9 /.-] or escape single quotes. Fold this into the village validation work.

known_issues.detail: CACHE_STORE_PATH = './output/.cache_store.json' is relative to the process CWD and ignores the output_dir argument entirely.
known_issues.impact: Blocks any global/installed CLI model; scatters output/ folders wherever the user happens to be.

known_issues.detail: '#!/usr/bin/env uv run python' works on macOS only. Verified failing on Linux semantics.
known_issues.workaround_in_docs: Documentation now uses 'uv run python dp-lookup-pro ...'.

known_issues.detail: Village, road and status strings are interpolated into raw KML. An & or < produces a file Google Earth refuses to parse.
Strings go straight into ReportLab Paragraph(), which parses a mini-XML markup language. A stray & or < raises during doc.build(), crashing the run after all network work has succeeded.
pyproject.toml has no [build-system] and no [project.scripts]. pip install, uvx and pipx are all impossible; the module only imports when CWD is the repo root.
pyproject declares pillow>=10.0.0, but ImageDraw.text(font_size=...) requires 10.1+. A resolver picking 10.0.x crashes during map rendering.
No test suite anywhere. Geometry, projection and DXF transform logic have no regression protection. lookup_plot_pro is a ~450-line function mixing network IO, geometry, rendering, export and logging.
README claims ~800ms fresh; MEMORY.md claims 2200-3000ms cold. Measured 2026-07-28: 6900-12991ms.

recent_fixes.summary: crz_restriction_layer_ids changed from 9 LINE layers to CRZ zone polygons [14, 1264, 1548].
recent_fixes.root_cause: Every previous ID was a boundary line. A point-identify at a plot centroid can never intersect a line, so CRZ could only ever return NO.
recent_fixes.validation: WORLI 886, WORLI 947 and BANDRA-A 409 flipped NO -> YES (CRZ II) and were confirmed against ground truth. BYCULLA 1605 and TARDEO 264 correctly stayed NO, proving the old false-positive bug was not reintroduced.

recent_fixes.summary: crz_status now reports the sub-tier by reading category / Category / CATEGORY / CLASS / Class, producing 'YES (CRZ II)' instead of a bare 'YES'.
Removed the two dead /query calls to layers 193/194 and added boundary-edge probes alongside the original centroid and bbox-corner probes.
recent_fixes.validation: MOHILI 732 went from road=None to 21.35. WORLI 947 (B G KHER 18.30 M) and BYCULLA 1605 (DR ANANDRAO L NAIR RD 45.72 M) both unchanged.
recent_fixes.caution: An earlier attempt REPLACED the bbox-corner probes and regressed WORLI 947. The probes are additive on purpose - do not remove the bbox corners.

recent_fixes.summary: Cleared the whole issue register: input whitelist + quote doubling, ArcGIS error-body detection via usable_json(), hard failure when the identify call fails, metadata.warnings + complete flag, degraded runs never cached, cache TTL (24h default) + use_cache/--no-cache + output-dir-relative store, XML/markup escaping in KML and ReportLab, hatchling packaging with a dp-lookup-pro console script, portable shebang, pillow>=10.1.0, 41 offline tests, corrected latency claims.
recent_fixes.validation: 41 pytest tests pass offline. All six verified plots re-run live with use_cache=False and returned complete=true with zero warnings: WORLI 947, WORLI 886, MOHILI 732, BYCULLA 1605, BANDRA-A 409, TARDEO 264.
recent_fixes.caution: Per-request timeout raised 10s -> 20s. The MCGM server throttles sustained bursts; space bulk lookups by ~10s or lookups will legitimately fail with ReadTimeout (which now surfaces as an error rather than a silently degraded report).

recent_fixes.summary: TTL raised 24h -> 30 days to match measured data velocity. Cache hits now verify every promised export file exists (a hit previously returned paths to deleted files and reported success), and report cached_at / cache_age_days / cache_expires_in_days.
recent_fixes.validation: 47 offline tests pass, including a regression that deletes a bundle file and asserts the entry is refused.

guidance_for_next_agent: Run `uv run pytest -q` before and after any change - there are now 41 offline tests covering projection maths, validation, escaping, cache TTL and the exporters.
The engine is cts_dp_lookup_pro.py. lookup_plot_pro is the single entry function and is ~450 lines.
Any change touching CRZ, roads or layer IDs MUST be regression-tested against verified_test_plots above, in BOTH directions - a coastal plot that should be YES and an inland plot that should be NO.
Clear ./output/.cache_store.json before any retest. Cached results will silently replay the old behaviour and make a fix look like it failed.
Never trust an empty result set as 'nothing found' - check for an 'error' key first. Three separate silent-failure paths have already been traced to this pattern.
Verify layer behaviour against the live server before assuming it: GET {SERVER_URL}?f=json lists every layer id and name.

The owner's stated priority is a simple install for non-technical users plus eventual commercialisation via a web app with logins. Prefer changes that reduce setup friction. Do not add an LLM dependency.
